verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can 'apply suggested changes directly to your PR with a single click—no copy-paste' and list '1-click fixes'. They also describe generated code changes, inline comments with suggested fixes on CI failures, and applying suggestions from inside Change Stack. Community commenters independently note CodeRabbit offers 'directly committable fixes' and suggested changes. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the suggestion-diff format and which Git platforms support one-click commit, and hands-on reports of actually applying a suggestion.
